summary: Extracts position or velocity textures from an Actor COMP that is part of a valid NVIDIA Flex simulation.

key_params.name: comp
key_params.note: Actor COMP to read simulation data from.

key_params.name: output
key_params.note: Return position or velocity simulation data.

key_params.name: format
key_params.note: Common TOP pixel format; keep float formats for data textures.

key_params.name: filtertype
key_params.note: Common TOP viewer filtering, relevant when inspecting float data.

common_gotchas: Official docs mark NVIDIA Flex TOP as Windows-only and NVIDIA-GPU-only.
The referenced Actor COMP must be controlled by an NVIDIA Flex Solver COMP in a valid Flex simulation.
Output data is stored in TOP color channels, commonly 32-bit float RGBA with XYZ components in RGB.
Use explicit pixel format expectations downstream when interpreting the texture as simulation data rather than display color.
key_concepts: Reads NVIDIA Flex simulation data from an Actor COMP.
The Actor COMP must be part of a valid Flex simulation controlled by an NVIDIA Flex Solver COMP.
Outputs either position or velocity as data textures rather than display color.
Texture color channels carry simulation components, such as XYZ in RGB for 32-bit float positional data.
